title: Enhancing activity and stability of RuO2 as a bifunctional catalyst using a thermally tuned α-MnO2 interlayer for hydrogen production
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,765-777
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01441C, Paper
Shashwat Bishwanathan, Simran Kaur Oberoi, Maurya Gyanprakash, Prashant Kumar Gupta
This study proposes a heterostructure electrode for commercial hydrogen generation utilizing thermally adjusted α-MnO2 and ultra-low RuO2. The suggested electrode exhibits remarkable stability and activity in AEMs.
